literal: If they had no wife or children, one person of the household was granted two years' remission.
idiomatic: If they had no wife or children, one person of the household was granted two years' remission.

literal: Those wounded in three places received one rank of reward;
idiomatic: Those wounded in three places received one rank of reward;

literal: Even with one wound, if the four limbs were crippled, the reward was the same.
idiomatic: Even with one wound, if the four limbs were crippled, the reward was the same.

literal: " Day gengchen: the prohibition on astronomical matters was reaffirmed; violators were sentenced to death.
idiomatic: " On the gengchen day the prohibition on astronomical matters was reaffirmed; violators were sentenced to death.

literal: Day yiyou: Dengzhi sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On the yiyou day Dengzhi sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Seventh month of autumn, day yichou: Divuoluo and Kasmira both sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the yichou day, Divuoluo and Kasmira both sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Day yihai: Director of the Secretariat, Equal in Rank with the Three Excellencies, Prince of Runan Yue was removed from office for killing a man and sent home as a prince.
idiomatic: On the yihai day Yue, director of the secretariat, equal in rank with the three excellencies, and Prince of Runan, was removed from office for killing a man and sent home as a prince.

literal: Day jisi: the imperial carriage performed rites at the Grand Temple.
idiomatic: On the jisi day the imperial carriage performed rites at the Grand Temple.

literal: Eighth month, day wuxu: clansmen of the lineage from Taizu aged fifteen and above were feasted in the Xianyang Hall and the rites of family kinship were observed.
idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the wuxu day, clansmen of the lineage from Taizu aged fifteen and above were feasted in the Xianyang Hall and the rites of family kinship were observed.

literal: Day jihai: an edict forbade commoner youths under fifteen from entering office.
idiomatic: On the jihai day an edict forbade commoner youths under fifteen from entering office.

literal: An edict said, "The Great Wei founded its state; its Way surpasses Zhou and Han; it linked the two capitals; its virtue flourished for a hundred generations; though imperial descendants multiplied and kin and worthies alike flourished, many still sank in plain conduct behind hemp cloth at the lane gate—not what is meant by broadly appointing the imperial kin to wing and screen the royal house.
idiomatic: An edict said, "The Great Wei founded its state; its Way surpasses Zhou and Han; it linked the two capitals; its virtue flourished for a hundred generations; though imperial descendants multiplied and kin and worthies alike flourished, many still sank in plain conduct behind hemp cloth at the lane gate—not what is meant by broadly appointing the imperial kin to wing and screen the royal house.

literal: Now according to nearness in generation they may be ranked in order of precedence.
idiomatic: Now according to nearness in generation they may be ranked in order of precedence.

literal: " Day gengzi: an edict ordered the children of the Princes of Xianyang and Jingzhao returned to their affiliated registers.
idiomatic: " On the gengzi day an edict ordered the children of the Princes of Xianyang and Jingzhao returned to their affiliated registers.

literal: Day renyin: Tuyuhun sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On the renyin day Tuyuhun sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Day dingwei: an edict ordered Attendant at the Secretariat, Grand Preceptor, Prince of Gaoyang Yong to enter the Gate Department and participate in deciding Secretariat memorials.
idiomatic: On the dingwei day an edict ordered Yong, attendant at the secretariat, grand preceptor, and Prince of Gaoyang, to enter the Gate Department and participate in deciding Secretariat memorials.

literal: Day jiyou: Khitan sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On the jiyou day Khitan sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Ninth month, day xinyou: Tuyuhun sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the xinyou day, Tuyuhun sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Day bingyin: an edict said, "Examining lawsuits and righting wrongs is truly the head of government; personally hearing and viewing is the source of the people's trust.
idiomatic: On the bingyin day an edict said, "Examining lawsuits and righting wrongs is truly the head of government; personally hearing and viewing is the source of the people's trust.

literal: Recently in the period of mourning seclusion the governing net was not yet taut; prisons were numerous and wide; laments and appeals were suddenly heard; though there were officials in charge, many cases were falsely blocked.
idiomatic: Recently in the period of mourning seclusion the governing net was not yet taut; prisons were numerous and wide; laments and appeals were suddenly heard; though there were officials in charge, many cases were falsely blocked.

literal: It is because our virtue is slight that we are deeply moved with compassion.
idiomatic: It is because our virtue is slight that we are deeply moved with compassion.

literal: From this month's full moon we shall for a time go outside the city gate and personally receive stagnant wrongs.
idiomatic: From this month's full moon we shall for a time go outside the city gate and personally receive stagnant wrongs.

literal: The chief officials should announce this near and far so all may hear and know."
idiomatic: The chief officials should announce this near and far so all may hear and know."

literal: That month seven cities were walled—Dongyang, Licheng, Xiaqiu, Pingliang, Feiru, Helong, and Jiuyuan—administered by the seven provinces Qing, Qi, Yan, Jing, Ping, Ying, and Si.
idiomatic: That month seven cities were walled—Dongyang, Licheng, Xiaqiu, Pingliang, Feiru, Helong, and Jiuyuan—administered by the seven provinces Qing, Qi, Yan, Jing, Ping, Ying, and Si.

literal: Tenth month of winter, day gengyin: because You, Ji, Cang, and Ying—four provinces—suffered great famine, Ministers Changsun Zhi, Deng Xian, and Yuan Zuan were sent to tour and comfort the people and open granaries for relief.
idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the gengyin day, because You, Ji, Cang, and Ying—four provinces—suffered great famine, Ministers Changsun Zhi, Deng Xian, and Yuan Zuan were sent to tour and comfort the people and open granaries for relief.

literal: Day dingyou: Wuji presented tribute arrows.
idiomatic: On the dingyou day Wuji presented tribute arrows.

literal: [2] Day wuxu: because Guangzhou was famished and distressed, envoys were sent to relieve the people.
idiomatic: [2] On the wuxu day, because Guangzhou was famished and distressed, envoys were sent to relieve the people.

literal: Day yimao: an edict said, "The northern capital is the root of our old domain; the imperial enterprise is founded there; two reigns since the southward move, many still remain.
idiomatic: On the yimao day an edict said, "The northern capital is the root of our old domain; the imperial enterprise is founded there; two reigns since the southward move, many still remain.

literal: Those who cherish their homeland and delight in the old and cannot yet leave themselves may all be allowed to stay on and settle in peace.
idiomatic: Those who cherish their homeland and delight in the old and cannot yet leave themselves may all be allowed to stay on and settle in peace.

literal: Those with talent and arts fit for the needs of the time will be summoned separately and are not within this rule.
idiomatic: Those with talent and arts fit for the needs of the time will be summoned separately and are not within this rule.

literal: The sons of Zhou and the Liu clan of Han spread throughout the realm and all flourished in number—how could they be confined to a thousand li north and south alone?"
idiomatic: The sons of Zhou and the Liu clan of Han spread throughout the realm and all flourished in number—how could they be confined to a thousand li north and south alone?"

literal: Eleventh month, day jiazi: Xiao Yan's General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Bazhou Mou Hanlong sent envoys to request surrender.
idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the jiazi day, Mou Hanlong, Xiao Yan's general who pacifies the west and inspector of Bazhou, sent envoys to request surrender.

literal: Twelfth month, day dingwei: Rouran sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the dingwei day, Rouran sent envoys with tribute.

literal: First month of spring in the first year of Shengui, day jiazi: an edict enfeoffed the Di chieftain Yang Ding as Prince of Yinping.
idiomatic: In the first month of spring in the first year of Shengui, on the jiazi day, an edict enfeoffed the Di chieftain Yang Ding as Prince of Yinping.

literal: Day bingyin: Special Advanced, Prince of Jiangyang Ji was made Grand General of Agile Cavalry and held equal precedence with the Three Excellencies.
idiomatic: On the bingyin day Ji, special advanced and Prince of Jiangyang, was made grand general of agile cavalry and held equal precedence with the three excellencies.

literal: Day renshen: an edict said, "We, young and dim, hold the mandate; the way of government is not yet at peace; the people's toils and pains we have not had leisure to record and comfort; morning and evening we are moved with compassion, waking and sleeping our hearts are deeply burdened; we look upon the hundred-year span and mourn these six extremities.
idiomatic: On the renshen day an edict said, "We, young and dim, hold the mandate; the way of government is not yet at peace; the people's toils and pains we have not had leisure to record and comfort; morning and evening we are moved with compassion, waking and sleeping our hearts are deeply burdened; we look upon the hundred-year span and mourn these six extremities.

literal: Within the capital districts those a hundred and above were granted a great commandery staff, those ninety and above a small commandery staff, those eighty and above a great county staff, those seventy and above a small county staff;
idiomatic: Within the capital districts those a hundred and above were granted a great commandery staff, those ninety and above a small commandery staff, those eighty and above a great county staff, those seventy and above a small county staff;

literal: Among the people of the provinces, those a hundred and above were granted a small commandery staff, those ninety and above an upper county staff, those eighty and above a middle county staff;
idiomatic: Among the people of the provinces, those a hundred and above were granted a small commandery staff, those ninety and above an upper county staff, those eighty and above a middle county staff;

literal: Widowers, widows, orphans, and the solitary who could not support themselves were granted five piculs of grain and two bolts of silk."
idiomatic: Widowers, widows, orphans, and the solitary who could not support themselves were granted five piculs of grain and two bolts of silk."

literal: Day gengchen: an edict ordered that among corvée households some had falsely entered the clear current; officeholders everywhere were each to guarantee one another in groups of five; those with no one to stand surety were stripped of office and returned to corvée.
idiomatic: On the gengchen day an edict ordered that among corvée households some had falsely entered the clear current; officeholders everywhere were each to guarantee one another in groups of five; those with no one to stand surety were stripped of office and returned to corvée.

literal: Day yiyou: Special Advanced, Prince of Runan Yue was given additional equal precedence with the Three Excellencies.
idiomatic: On the yiyou day Yue, special advanced and Prince of Runan, was given additional equal precedence with the three excellencies.

literal: Qinzhou Di rebelled.
idiomatic: The Di of Qinzhou rebelled.

literal: Youzhou suffered great famine; three thousand seven hundred ninety-nine people died; an edict ordered Inspector Zhao Yong to open granaries for relief.
idiomatic: Youzhou suffered great famine; three thousand seven hundred ninety-nine people died; an edict ordered Zhao Yong, inspector, to open granaries for relief.

literal: Second month, day wushen: Yanda, Goryeo, Wuji, Tuyuhun, Dangchang, Shule, Jiumotuo, Mojuoban, and other states [3] all sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: In the second month, on the wushen day, Yanda, Goryeo, Wuji, Tuyuhun, Dangchang, Shule, Jiumotuo, Mojuoban, and other states [3] all sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Day jiyou: an edict, because of the Shengui auspicious omen, proclaimed a general amnesty and changed the reign title.
idiomatic: On the jiyou day an edict, because of the Shengui auspicious omen, proclaimed a general amnesty and changed the reign title.

literal: East Yizhou Di rebelled.
idiomatic: The Di of East Yizhou rebelled.

literal: Rouran sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: Rouran sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Third month, day xinyou: Right Vice Director Yu Zhong was given equal precedence with the Three Excellencies.
idiomatic: In the third month, on the xinyou day, Yu Zhong, right vice director, was given equal precedence with the three excellencies.

literal: Day xinsi: Yu Zhong, Equal in Rank with the Three Excellencies and Right Vice Director, died.
idiomatic: On the xinsi day Yu Zhong, equal in rank with the three excellencies and right vice director, died.

literal: South Qinzhou Di rebelled; General of Dragon Cavalry Cui Xi was sent bearing credentials to instruct them.
idiomatic: The Di of South Qinzhou rebelled; Cui Xi, general of dragon cavalry, was sent bearing credentials to instruct them.

literal: Tuyuhun sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: Tuyuhun sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Fourth month of summer, day dingyou: Minister of Works Hu Guozhen died.
idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the dingyou day, Hu Guozhen, minister of works, died.

literal: Day jiachen: Prince of Jiangyang Ji was enfeoffed afresh as Prince of Jingzhao.
idiomatic: On the jiachen day Ji, Prince of Jiangyang, was enfeoffed afresh as Prince of Jingzhao.

literal: Day xinhai: Shemo sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On the xinhai day Shemo sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Fifth month: Goryeo, Gaoche, and Gaochang all sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: In the fifth month Goryeo, Gaoche, and Gaochang all sent envoys with tribute.

literal: From the first month there was no rain until the sixth month, day xinmao; soaking rain then fell.
idiomatic: From the first month there was no rain until the sixth month, on the xinmao day; soaking rain then fell.

literal: Seventh month of autumn: the people of Hezhou, Que Tiecong, gathered a crowd and rebelled and styled himself King of the Water Pool.
idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn the people of Hezhou, Que Tiecong, gathered a crowd and rebelled and styled himself King of the Water Pool.

literal: An edict ordered Mobile Headquarters Yuan Zigong to attack him.
idiomatic: An edict ordered Yuan Zigong, mobile headquarters, to attack him.

literal: Intercalary month, day wuxu: Tuyuhun sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on the wuxu day, Tuyuhun sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Day jiachen: the prohibition on Yinshan silver mines in Hengzhou was lifted and shared with the people.
idiomatic: On the jiachen day the prohibition on Yinshan silver mines in Hengzhou was lifted and shared with the people.

literal: Day dingwei: Persia, Shule, Wuchang, and Kucha all sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On the dingwei day Persia, Shule, Wuchang, and Kucha all sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Eighth month, day guichou, new moon: an edict said, "We, young and dim, have succeeded to the calendar and are not yet skilled in the way of government; the empress dowager, in deep sorrow, has begun to view the myriad affairs.
idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the guichou day, the new moon, an edict said, "We, young and dim, have succeeded to the calendar and are not yet skilled in the way of government; the empress dowager, in deep sorrow, has begun to view the myriad affairs.

literal: Therefore prisoners linger in wrongful detention and the people suffer injustice; thinking of excessive punishments, we wish to reduce and lighten them; prisoners seen in the capital, from death downward, may all have their sentence reduced one degree."
idiomatic: Therefore prisoners linger in wrongful detention and the people suffer injustice; thinking of excessive punishments, we wish to reduce and lighten them; prisoners seen in the capital, from death downward, may all have their sentence reduced one degree."

literal: Day dingsi: an edict said, "In recent years war-chariots have moved frequently; mourning garments are not yet ended yet grief is set aside to follow service.
idiomatic: On the dingsi day an edict said, "In recent years war-chariots have moved frequently; mourning garments are not yet ended yet grief is set aside to follow service.

literal: The pain of boundless loss is not expressed; the grace of nurturing is not repaid—this is not what is called honoring the utmost Way.
idiomatic: The pain of boundless loss is not expressed; the grace of nurturing is not repaid—this is not what is called honoring the utmost Way.

literal: From now on, even when there are campaigns in metal and hide, none may request leave for home mourning."
idiomatic: From now on, even when there are campaigns in metal and hide, none may request leave for home mourning."

literal: Day jiazi: Wuji sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On the jiazi day Wuji sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Tiecong and his followers successively surrendered to Mobile Headquarters Yuan Zigong.
idiomatic: Tiecong and his followers successively surrendered to Yuan Zigong, mobile headquarters.

literal: Ninth month, day guiwei, new moon: Right Honorable Grand Master Liu Teng was made General of the Guard and held equal precedence with the Three Excellencies.
idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the guiwei day, the new moon, Liu Teng, right honorable grand master, was made general of the guard and held equal precedence with the three excellencies.

literal: Day wushen: Empress Dowager Gao died at the Yaoguang Temple.
idiomatic: On the wushen day Empress Dowager Gao died at the Yaoguang Temple.

literal: Tenth month of winter, day dingmao: she was buried at Beimang by nun rites.
idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the dingmao day, she was buried at Beimang by nun rites.

literal: Twelfth month, day xinwei: an edict said, "Human life has an end and all return to the burial ground; within the capital hidden and exposed corpses number in the hundred millions; noble and base alike have no fixed place; as parents of the people we should especially preserve and comfort them.
idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the xinwei day, an edict said, "Human life has an end and all return to the burial ground; within the capital hidden and exposed corpses number in the hundred millions; noble and base alike have no fixed place; as parents of the people we should especially preserve and comfort them.

literal: Now west of Mount Ganpu is designated as the place for Jiuyuan."
idiomatic: Now west of Mount Ganpu is designated as the place for Jiuyuan."

literal: First month of spring in the second year, day dinghai: an edict said, "We, young and slight, have succeeded to the precious throne; morning and evening we are reverent, as if crossing a deep sea.
idiomatic: In the first month of spring in the second year, on the dinghai day, an edict said, "We, young and slight, have succeeded to the precious throne; morning and evening we are reverent, as if crossing a deep sea.

literal: We rely on the empress dowager's compassionate benevolence, covered with early instruction.
idiomatic: We rely on the empress dowager's compassionate benevolence, covered with early instruction.

literal: Since holding court and treading the pinnacle, nearly half a reign has passed; heaven is level and earth at peace; within the four seas there is quiet.
idiomatic: Since holding court and treading the pinnacle, nearly half a reign has passed; heaven is level and earth at peace; within the four seas there is quiet.

literal: The Way of Heaven is high and far, lofty and hard to name; yet we still restrain ourselves and hold back, our title not complete—not what is meant by honoring and serving Earth's origin and harmonizing with the hundred millions.
idiomatic: The Way of Heaven is high and far, lofty and hard to name; yet we still restrain ourselves and hold back, our title not complete—not what is meant by honoring and serving Earth's origin and harmonizing with the hundred millions.

literal: We should follow the old canon and proclaim our title throughout the realm, to answer the hope of the black-haired masses."
idiomatic: We should follow the old canon and proclaim our title throughout the realm, to answer the hope of the black-haired masses."

literal: That month Empress Wenzhao of the Gao clan was reburied.
idiomatic: That month Empress Wenzhao of the Gao clan was reburied.

literal: Second month, day yichou: Prince of Qi Commandery You died.
idiomatic: In the second month, on the yichou day, You, Prince of Qi commandery, died.

literal: Day gengwu: more than a thousand guardsmen burned the residence of General Who Campaigns West Zhang Yi, beat Yi, and burned and killed his son Shi Jun.
idiomatic: On the gengwu day more than a thousand guardsmen burned the residence of Zhang Yi, general who campaigns west, beat Yi, and burned and killed his son Shi Jun.

literal: Tuyuhun and Dangchang both sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: Tuyuhun and Dangchang both sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Day yihai: a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
idiomatic: On the yihai day a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

literal: Day dingchou: an edict sought forthright speech; those who submitted memorials were permitted to seal them and have them forwarded.
idiomatic: On the dingchou day an edict sought forthright speech; those who submitted memorials were permitted to seal them and have them forwarded.

literal: Day renyin: an edict said, "In the crucial month of farming the seasonal rains have not responded; the good grain is not yet gathered; the three wheats wither.
idiomatic: On the renyin day an edict said, "In the crucial month of farming the seasonal rains have not responded; the good grain is not yet gathered; the three wheats wither.

literal: That virtue has no effect fills us with sighs and fear together.
idiomatic: That virtue has no effect fills us with sighs and fear together.

literal: Let inner and outer offices follow the old rain-prayer and lead the sacrificial canon.
idiomatic: Let inner and outer offices follow the old rain-prayer and lead the sacrificial canon.

literal: Examine prisons and right wrongs; cover exposed corpses and bury bones.
idiomatic: Examine prisons and right wrongs; cover exposed corpses and bury bones.

literal: In the Ji and Ying regions, which formerly suffered raids, the dead were many and white bones lay across the roads—special commissioners may be sent to gather and bury them.
idiomatic: In the Ji and Ying regions, which formerly suffered raids, the dead were many and white bones lay across the roads—special commissioners may be sent to gather and bury them.

literal: Relieve the poor and comfort the widowed; heal the sick and preserve the aged; consult former models and see that all is thoroughly done."
idiomatic: Relieve the poor and comfort the widowed; heal the sick and preserve the aged; consult former models and see that all is thoroughly done."

literal: Third month, day jiachen: soaking rain fell abundantly.
idiomatic: In the third month, on the jiachen day, soaking rain fell abundantly.

literal: Fourth month of summer, day yichou: Yanda sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the yichou day, Yanda sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Fifth month, day wuxu: Minister of Works, Prince of Rencheng Cheng was made Minister over the Masses; Grand General of Agile Cavalry, Equal in Rank with the Three Excellencies, Prince of Jingzhao Ji was made Minister of Works.
idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the wuxu day, Cheng, minister of works and Prince of Rencheng, was made minister over the masses; Ji, grand general of agile cavalry, equal in rank with the three excellencies, and Prince of Jingzhao, was made minister of works.

literal: Eighth month of autumn, day jiwei: Censor-in-Chief, Prince of Dongping Kuang was punished for an offense and stripped of office and rank.
idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn, on the jiwei day, Kuang, censor-in-chief and Prince of Dongping, was punished for an offense and stripped of office and rank.

literal: Day xinwei: Left Honorable Grand Master Huangfu Ji was made General Who Campaigns West and held equal precedence with the Three Excellencies.
idiomatic: On the xinwei day Huangfu Ji, left honorable grand master, was made general who campaigns west and held equal precedence with the three excellencies.

literal: Ninth month, day gengyin: the empress dowager visited Mount Song;
idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the gengyin day, the empress dowager visited Mount Song;

literal: Day guisi: she returned to the palace.
idiomatic: On the guisi day she returned to the palace.

literal: The people of Yingzhou, Liu Xuanming, plotted rebellion; when the matter was discovered he was executed.
idiomatic: The people of Yingzhou, Liu Xuanming, plotted rebellion; when the matter was discovered he was executed.

literal: Eleventh month of winter, day yiyou: Rouran's Mohulian Hehoudou led seven hundred men and women to come and surrender.
idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, on the yiyou day, Rouran's Mohulian Hehoudou led seven hundred men and women to come and surrender.

literal: Twelfth month, day guichou: Minister over the Masses, Prince of Rencheng Cheng died.
idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the guichou day, Cheng, minister over the masses and Prince of Rencheng, died.

literal: Day gengshen: a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
idiomatic: On the gengshen day a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
